scenes.stage_direction: The room grows quieter as live contact approaches. The last call is real; physical reunion is still beyond this campaign.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She has acknowledged Ethan's relationship to Adrian and withdrawn the earlier denial.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: She can ask about forgiveness another day.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Kellan is challenging the chain of evidence. We need every hand the records passed through.

metadata.evidence_summary: A public denial used to obstruct the search is withdrawn.
